---
title: A project copy of iconify that filters does not name
author: Test Author
date: 2026-01-01
engine: markdown
format:
  mcanouil-html: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The project copy of iconify gives the shortcode, but filters does not name it, so the page warns once that the embedded filter runs with it.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: '\[embedded\] iconify: .*Name the copy in `filters`\.'
        count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['id="project-iconify"']
        - []
---
